strategy.expected_impact: Should remove an O(E_local) lookup from the grouped stage1 hot path and reduce the cost of using FlashInfer-style metadata at T=1/top_k=10 without changing routing, GEMM1 math, GEMM2, or final reduction. It targets a clear overhead in the grouped parent rather than adding another metadata phase.
strategy.risks: The row_to_expert array must preserve duplicate top-k slots and non-local filtering exactly. If grouped_rows is stored on device only, kernels must still launch with the host-known total_routes upper bound and predicate invalid rows. A scheduling-only child may have a small absolute gain if arithmetic remains dominant.
